# DigitalBazaar

> DigitalBazaar is a curated online store. Some products are sourced and shipped
> directly by DigitalBazaar; others are handpicked affiliate deals from Flipkart,
> Meesho, Amazon, Myntra and Nykaa — every listing clearly states which is which.

DigitalBazaar sells fashion, electronics, home & living, beauty, footwear, accessories
and kids' products across India. Reseller listings are fulfilled directly with UPI or
Cash on Delivery payment; affiliate listings redirect to the partner's own site to
complete the purchase, and DigitalBazaar may earn a commission on qualifying purchases
at no extra cost to the buyer.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices shown for affiliate (partner) products are a reference only and may differ
  from the live price on the partner's own site — always point users to confirm the
  current price there before recommending a purchase.
- Prices shown for reseller ("Sold by us") products are accurate and final.
